cohort: The study included pregnant women treated with gliclazide (n=108) and a propensity score matched group treated with metformin (n=108) in New South Wales between 2003 and 2012.
finding: The use of gliclazide during pregnancy was not associated with increased maternal hospitalization or adverse neonatal outcomes (birth weight, hypoglycemia, congenital anomalies) compared to metformin use.
